title: Dynamics of p53 DNA binding sites contributes to functional selectivity of p53-driven gene expression
authors: Jessy Safieh; Ariel Chazan; Pratik Vyas; Hanna Saleem; Yael Danin-Poleg; Dina Ron; Tali E. Haran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究p53转录因子响应元件DNA柔性对靶基因表达时序的调控，虽聚焦TF-DNA体系但方法以序列柔性计算和实验验证为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故为中档匹配。
abstract: The tumor suppressor protein p53 is situated in the midst of a complex network that is activated in response to cellular stress. An unresolved question is how p53 activates its myriad target genes in response to the severity of the stress signal and consequently coordinates the functional outcome in a timely manner. We have previously shown that DNA torsional flexibility distinguishes among p53 response elements (REs). Here we calculated the flexibility of over 200 p53 REs. By connecting functional pathways of p53-dependent genes to the calculated flexibility of their REs, we show that genes belonging to pathways activated rapidly upon stress (e.g., cell-cycle arrest, energy metabolism and innate immunity) contain REs that are significantly more flexible relative to REs of genes involved in pathways that need to be more strictly regulated or are activated later in the response to stress (e.g., intrinsic apoptosis and p53 negative regulation). The global structural properties of several p53 REs belonging to the different pathways were experimentally validated. Additionally, reporter gene expression driven by flexible p53 REs occurred at lower p53 levels and with faster rates than expression from rigid REs. Moreover, analysis of published endogenous mRNA levels of p53 target genes as a function of the flexibility of their REs support our hypothesis. Overall, we demonstrate that DNA flexibility of p53 REs contributes significantly to the timely expression of p53 target genes and thereby plays an important role in cell-faith decisions in the p53 circuity.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制蛋白p53位于一个复杂的网络中，该网络响应细胞应激而被激活。一个未解决的问题是，p53如何根据应激信号的严重程度激活其众多靶基因，并因此及时协调功能结果。我们先前已表明，DNA扭转灵活性可区分p53响应元件（REs）。在此，我们计算了超过200个p53 REs的灵活性。通过将p53依赖性基因的功能通路与其REs的计算灵活性相关联，我们显示，属于应激后快速激活通路（如细胞周期阻滞、能量代谢和先天免疫）的基因，其REs相对于那些需要更严格调控或在应激反应后期激活的通路（如内源性凋亡和p53负调控）中的基因REs，显著更具灵活性。属于不同通路的几个p53 REs的全局结构特性已通过实验验证。此外，由柔性p53 REs驱动的报告基因表达发生在较低的p53水平下，且速率快于刚性REs的表达。而且，对已发表的p53靶基因内源mRNA水平随其REs灵活性变化的分析支持了我们的假设。总体而言，我们证明p53 REs的DNA灵活性对p53靶基因的及时表达有显著贡献，从而在p53回路中的细胞命运决定中发挥重要作用。
